---
title: "Stage 1 — the USDM fragment"
---

The study as data: objectives, endpoints, estimands, arms, population, and the concepts the
endpoints are measured by.

## What this is

USDM is CDISC's Unified Study Definition Model — a JSON representation of what a protocol
says. A *fragment* is the part needed for the endpoints being carried, not a whole digitised
protocol.

## What you do

Author or generate the fragment, then load it in the builder and look at it. A fragment that
does not render is not finished, whatever the schema says.

## What you should see

A study that appears in the application's study list, with its objectives and endpoints
showing.

## What to look out for

**Authoring it by hand teaches you the model; regenerating it is what makes it true.** This
project did stage 1 before stage 0, in the wrong order, and the fragment then had to be
regenerated once the protocol was restructured.

If you are learning, hand-author once — the shape sticks. Then throw it away and generate.
